## Module to write
path: ServerScriptService/DataService.luau
purpose: Feature: Data saving: a DataService on the server saves each player's Cash, TotalEarned, Rebirths and owned upgrade ids with DataStoreService (store 'CubeCashTycoon_v1', key 'p_<UserId>'), loading on join before their Tycoon starts (re-applying owned upgrades), autosaving every 60 seconds, on PlayerRemoving and in game:BindToClose. Every DataStore call is wrapped in pcall with a couple of retries; when DataStore is unavailable (Studio without API access, or any error) it falls back to an in-memory table so the game still runs with no errors or warnings in the output (one quiet print, never warn). Bump counters data_loaded and data_saved. -- ModuleScript owning all persistence. It returns a table with these functions. DataService.init() runs once: it creates the store, starts the 60s autosave loop (task.spawn with task.wait(60), saving every loaded player), connects Players.PlayerRemoving (save, then drop the cache) and sets game:BindToClose to save all loaded players. It does not require Tycoon or the claim logic. DataService.loadPlayer(player) yields. It reads key 'p_'..UserId through a retrying pcall wrapper and falls back to the in-memory table on failure. It normalises the result to {Cash=0, TotalEarned=0, Rebirths=0, Upgrades={}}, caches it per player, and bumps ForgeTelemetry.count('data_loaded',1) exactly once per player. DataService.applyPlayer(player) waits up to about 10s for player.leaderstats, then sets Cash, TotalEarned and Rebirths from the cache. It restores the Rebirths state through RebirthService and the owned ids through UpgradeService.restoreOwned(player, ids). It is safe to call even if loadPlayer failed (defaults). DataService.savePlayer(player) snapshots the current Cash, TotalEarned and Rebirths (from leaderstats or the owning service) plus UpgradeService.getOwnedIds(player). It writes with UpdateAsync or SetAsync inside a pcall with 3 attempts and task.wait(1) between them, and falls back to the memory table. It skips players whose data was never loaded, so a fresh default cannot overwrite a real save. A per-player saving flag prevents duplicate saves from PlayerRemoving plus BindToClose. It bumps ForgeTelemetry.count('data_saved',1) once per successful save, whether to DataStore or to memory. Persistence uses DataStoreService:GetDataStore('CubeCashTycoon_v1'), obtained inside a pcall. If that fails or a call errors, the service sets useMemory=true and prints one quiet message ('DataService: using in-memory store') a single time. It never calls warn or error. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: data_loaded, data_saved.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau, ServerScriptService/UpgradeService.luau, ServerScriptService/RebirthService.luau

### ReplicatedStorage/ForgeTelemetry.luau
```luau
--!strict
-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry
```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.
- Define the data shape that a builder module returns (field names such as origin, gate, spawn) once, and have consumers use those exact fields. Do not add `a or b` fallbacks for guessed names.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.
- When the spec changes the flow (e.g. from auto-assign to claim), rewrite the entry script (Game.server) to require and wire the new modules, and delete the old flow's logic (slots, teleport on join). Updating only the new modules leaves the old behaviour running.
- After a redesign, check that every module is required by the entry script and that its init function is called. Unwired modules never run, and their counters never fire.

```luau
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))

local STORE_NAME = "CubeCashTycoon_v1"
local ATTEMPTS = 3

local DataService = {}

local store: any = nil
local useMemory = false
local printedMemory = false
local initialized = false
local memory: { [string]: any } = {}
local cache: { [Player]: any } = {}
local loaded: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
local saving: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
local countedLoad: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

local function switchToMemory()
	useMemory = true
	if not printedMemory then
		printedMemory = true
		print("DataService: using in-memory store")
	end
end

local function keyFor(player: Player): string
	return "p_" .. tostring(player.UserId)
end

local function getService(name: string): any
	local inst = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild(name) or ServerScriptService:WaitForChild(name, 10)
	if not inst then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, inst)
	if ok then
		return mod
	end
	return nil
end

local function retry(fn: () -> any): (boolean, any)
	local lastErr: any = nil
	for attempt = 1, ATTEMPTS do
		local ok, res = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, res
		end
		lastErr = res
		if attempt < ATTEMPTS then
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end
	return false, lastErr
end

local function normalise(raw: any): any
	local data = { Cash = 0, TotalEarned = 0, Rebirths = 0, Upgrades = {} }
	if type(raw) == "table" then
		if type(raw.Cash) == "number" then
			data.Cash = math.max(0, math.floor(raw.Cash))
		end
		if type(raw.TotalEarned) == "number" then
			data.TotalEarned = math.max(0, math.floor(raw.TotalEarned))
		end
		if type(raw.Rebirths) == "number" then
			data.Rebirths = math.max(0, math.floor(raw.Rebirths))
		end
		if type(raw.Upgrades) == "table" then
			for _, id in raw.Upgrades do
				if type(id) == "string" then
					table.insert(data.Upgrades, id)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return data
end

local function copyData(d: any): any
	return normalise(d)
end

local function getStat(player: Player, name: string): any
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not ls then
		return nil
	end
	local v = ls:FindFirstChild(name)
	if v and (v:IsA("IntValue") or v:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return v
	end
	return nil
end

function DataService.loadPlayer(player: Player)
	local key = keyFor(player)
	local raw: any = nil
	if not useMemory and store then
		local ok, res = retry(function()
			return store:GetAsync(key)
		end)
		if ok then
			raw = res
		else
			switchToMemory()
			raw = memory[key]
		end
	else
		raw = memory[key]
	end
	if not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	cache[player] = normalise(raw)
	loaded[player] = true
	if not countedLoad[player] then
		countedLoad[player] = true
		ForgeTelemetry.count("data_loaded", 1)
	end
end

function DataService.applyPlayer(player: Player)
	local data = cache[player]
	if not data then
		data = normalise(nil)
		cache[player] = data
	end
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 10)
	if ls then
		local cash = getStat(player, "Cash")
		if cash then
			cash.Value = data.Cash
		end
		local total = getStat(player, "TotalEarned")
		if total then
			total.Value = data.TotalEarned
		end
		local rb = getStat(player, "Rebirths")
		if rb then
			rb.Value = data.Rebirths
		end
	end
	player:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", data.TotalEarned)

	local rebirth = getService("RebirthService")
	if rebirth and type(rebirth.restoreRebirths) == "function" then
		pcall(rebirth.restoreRebirths, player, data.Rebirths)
	end
	local upgrades = getService("UpgradeService")
	if upgrades and type(upgrades.restoreOwned) == "function" then
		pcall(upgrades.restoreOwned, player, table.clone(data.Upgrades))
	end
end

local function snapshot(player: Player): any
	local data = cache[player] or normalise(nil)
	local snap = copyData(data)
	local cash = getStat(player, "Cash")
	if cash then
		snap.Cash = math.max(0, math.floor(cash.Value))
	end
	local total = getStat(player, "TotalEarned")
	if total then
		snap.TotalEarned = math.max(0, math.floor(total.Value))
	else
		local attr = player:GetAttribute("TotalEarned")
		if type(attr) == "number" then
			snap.TotalEarned = math.max(0, math.floor(attr))
		end
	end
	local rb = getStat(player, "Rebirths")
	if rb then
		snap.Rebirths = math.max(0, math.floor(rb.Value))
	end
	local upgrades = getService("UpgradeService")
	if upgrades and type(upgrades.getOwnedIds) == "function" then
		local ok, ids = pcall(upgrades.getOwnedIds, player)
		if ok and type(ids) == "table" then
			local list = {}
			for _, id in ids do
				if type(id) == "string" then
					table.insert(list, id)
				end
			end
			snap.Upgrades = list
		end
	end
	return snap
end

function DataService.savePlayer(player: Player)
	if not loaded[player] or saving[player] then
		return
	end
	saving[player] = true
	local snap = snapshot(player)
	cache[player] = copyData(snap)
	local key = keyFor(player)
	local saved = false
	if not useMemory and store then
		local ok = retry(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function()
				return snap
			end)
			return true
		end)
		if ok then
			saved = true
		else
			switchToMemory()
		end
	end
	if not saved then
		memory[key] = copyData(snap)
		saved = true
	end
	saving[player] = false
	if saved then
		ForgeTelemetry.count("data_saved", 1)
	end
end

function DataService.init()
	if initialized then
		return
	end
	initialized = true

	local ok, ds = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)
	end)
	if ok and ds then
		store = ds
	else
		switchToMemory()
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(60)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if loaded[player] then
					task.spawn(DataService.savePlayer, player)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local waited = 0
		while saving[player] and waited < 10 do
			task.wait(0.25)
			waited += 0.25
		end
		DataService.savePlayer(player)
		cache[player] = nil
		loaded[player] = nil
		saving[player] = nil
		countedLoad[player] = nil
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		local pending = 0
		for player in loaded do
			if player.Parent then
				pending += 1
				task.spawn(function()
					local waited = 0
					while saving[player] and waited < 10 do
						task.wait(0.25)
						waited += 0.25
					end
					DataService.savePlayer(player)
					pending -= 1
				end)
			end
		end
		local t = 0
		while pending > 0 and t < 25 do
			task.wait(0.25)
			t += 0.25
		end
	end)
end

return DataService
```
